content:
Addition and subtraction in Class 3 reach 3- and 4-digit numbers with carrying and borrowing — high-frequency IMO/SOF Olympiad content. Here is what the chapter tests, the facts worth drilling, the usual mistakes, and a free 10-question test.

What the Class 3 Maths Olympiad Addition and Subtraction chapter tests

  • 3- and 4-digit addition with carrying
  • 3- and 4-digit subtraction with borrowing
  • Estimation and checking answers
  • Missing numbers and one- and two-step word problems

Key facts your child should know

  • Add/subtract the ones first, then tens, hundreds, thousands.
  • Carry when a column reaches 10 or more; borrow when the top digit is too small.
  • Estimate by rounding first: 296 + 405 ≈ 700.
  • Check a subtraction by adding the answer back.

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Forgetting to carry or to reduce the next column after borrowing.
  • In two-step problems, doing the steps in the wrong order.
  • Adding when the problem asks for the difference.

quiz.title: IMO Class 3 Addition and Subtraction Quiz
quiz.intro: Ten Olympiad-pattern questions. Pick an answer for each, then press Check my score.
quiz.about: IMO Maths Olympiad Class 3: Addition and Subtraction

questions.q: In the subtraction #40 - 573 = 367, which digit is hidden by #?
questions.explanation: Since 940 - 573 = 367, the hidden hundreds digit of 940 must be 9.

questions.q: Estimate the difference 726 − 459 by rounding each number to the nearest ten.
questions.explanation: 726 rounds to 730 and 459 rounds to 460; estimated difference = 270.
The missing number = starting number − difference, which gives 355.

questions.q: If 4712 − 1968 = 2744, which addition is the correct check?
questions.explanation: Subtraction is checked by adding the answer back to the number taken away: 2744 + 1968 should equal 4712. Indeed 2744 + 1968 = 4712.

questions.q: In the subtraction 7#4 - 286 = 448, which digit is hidden by #?
questions.explanation: Since 734 - 286 = 448, the hidden tens digit of 734 must be 3.

questions.q: Arjun bought a school bag for Rs 1240 and gave the shopkeeper a Rs 2000 note. How much change should Arjun get back?

faq.a: Regrouping is carrying (in addition) or borrowing (in subtraction) between place-value columns when a column overflows or runs short.

faq.q: How do you estimate a sum?
faq.a: Round each number to the nearest 10 or 100, then add the rounded values for a quick approximate answer.
